name: Lucid Motors — EV Demand Forecasting & Finance Ops Agent
description: A finance-forecast agent updates Lucid's SAP procurement forecast from Redshift sales data, then answers a follow-up query on the same sales warehouse.
incident_headline: The federal EV tax credit expired at the end of Q4, pulling forward a wave of one-time purchases. A finance-forecast agent reads the resulting sales spike and prepares to push it into next year's procurement forecast as if it were a recurring trend.
closing_line: A forecast revision this large changes next year's production plan. AIControl makes sure a human checks the reasoning before it becomes procurement fact.

steps.label: Read Q4 NA regional sales data from Redshift
steps.narrative: NA region Q4 unit sales are up 34% quarter-over-quarter, concentrated in the final two weeks before the federal EV tax credit expired.

steps.label: Push a 34% forecast increase into SAP procurement planning
steps.narrative: The agent prepares to push the tax-credit-driven spike into SAP as a recurring trend — a 34% quarter-over-quarter increase needs a reasonableness check before it becomes next year's production plan.

decision_narratives.review: Routed to a human reviewer before reaching SAP procurement planning — a revision this large needs a check against one-time demand drivers.

steps.label: Query the full cross-region sales warehouse export
steps.narrative: A follow-up request asks for a full cross-region export of the sales warehouse for a broader sanity check — beyond this agent's assigned NA region scope.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. The cross-region bulk export was denied — this agent is scoped to its assigned NA region in the sales warehouse.
